title: The night markets
content: I found myself walking through the night markets over and over last night. I would wake up and fall back asleep only to find myself headed back there. The entrance was different each time dependent on where I was prior. Once in there it’s the same tightly aisled shops. Chinese pastries, incense, tchotchke and random antiques and jewelry. This time I was trying to find something and was being yelled at by the shopkeepers. Has anyone else been to these markets?
